url.description: Target URL (http/https). SSRF-guarded: loopback, RFC1918, link-local, multicast, broadcast, and cloud metadata 169.254.169.254 are blocked by default.

body.description: UTF-8 request body. Mutually exclusive with body_base64.

body_base64.description: Base64-encoded binary request body. Mutually exclusive with body. Decoded size capped at 25 MiB.

max_retries.description: Retries on 429/5xx and transport failures; deterministic failures (SSRF block, oversize response) are never retried.

follow_redirects.description: Follow redirects when true; otherwise the 3xx status is returned as-is.

max_redirects.description: Redirect cap when follow_redirects is true. Every hop still resolves through the SSRF-guarded resolver.

status.description: Final HTTP status, or 0 when no response was obtained (SSRF block, transport failure).

body.description: Response text as-is when valid UTF-8, otherwise base64 (see body_encoding).

NETWORK_PLUGIN_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Allowlist mode (default-deny): comma-separated IPs/hostnames reachable at all. Built-in RFC1918/loopback ranges stop being consulted for listed hosts.

NETWORK_PLUGIN_EXTRA_BLOCKED_HOSTS.description: Extra SSRF blocklist: comma-separated IPs and/or bare hostnames, matched before DNS resolution. Applied on top of the allowlist.

NETWORK_PLUGIN_PROXY_URL.description: Optional HTTP proxy. Once set, the SSRF blocklist no longer covers hosts reached through it — only enable pointed at a trusted proxy.

NETWORK_PLUGIN_CA_BUNDLE_PATH.description: Path to one or more PEM-encoded CA certificates, trusted in addition to the built-in root store.

NETWORK_PLUGIN_CLIENT_IDENTITY_PATH.description: Path to a single PEM file with client certificate + private key (concatenated) for mutual TLS.

NETWORK_PLUGIN_MAX_INFLIGHT_PER_CALLER.description: Per-caller in-flight request cap so one noisy plugin can't monopolize outbound connections. 0 = unlimited.
